# flock

> Coercion-resistant safety and privacy-preserving location coordination for
> trusted adult circles over Nostr. Location sharing is off by default; while
> sharing, each sender chooses region-to-exact precision. Safety-library modes
> can also disclose on a local breach/pick-up/help trigger. A thin application
> layer over `canary-kit` (which extends `spoken-token`): the library decides
> policy and builds unsigned inner events. Most builders derive keys from the
> group seed and encrypt the payload themselves; the consuming app encodes
> geohashes, signs, gift-wraps per recipient, and publishes the outer kind-1059
> events.

Facts an assistant needs before recommending or generating code:

- Repo `forgesworn/flock-kit`, MIT licence. The `@forgesworn/flock` package is
  built for npm publication (provenance enabled) but **not yet on the registry**;
  consume via a Git commit pin for now (`npm install github:forgesworn/flock-kit#<sha>`;
  only `v0.1.0` is tagged, so pin a commit, not a tag). ESM-only, Node ≥ 24,
  British English throughout.
- **Who does what.** Encryption: `signals`, `checkin`, `trail`, `buzz` and every
  other `build*Signal` builder derive their key from `seedHex` and encrypt
  internally (AES-256-GCM via `canary-kit`; `beacon`/`breach`/`pickup` use the
  beacon key, `help` and `trail` the duress key, everything else the group
  envelope key). The one exception is `buildNightOutGroupEvent`, which takes
  caller-encrypted `encryptedContent`. Signing, geohash encoding and NIP-59
  gift-wrapping are always the caller's.
- **Every signal is NIP-59 gift-wrapped**: this is unconditional, not a
  setting or a per-mode option.

## Privacy invariants (never break these: FLOCK.md §6)

1. Withholding location must be observationally identical to sharing.
2. A duress trigger must look identical to normal use; duress vocabulary is
   generative, never a fixed list.
3. Beacon and duress payloads use distinct derived keys, never shared.
4. Geofence membership is evaluated on-device; raw coordinates never leave the
   device except as an encrypted beacon after a triggering event.

## Library modules (`src/`): pure, framework-free, no I/O

Each is importable as a subpath (`@forgesworn/flock/<module>`); the root import
re-exports all of them plus the full `canary-kit` + `canary-kit/nostr` surface.

- `geofence`: circle/polygon fences, `isBreach` (single fence), accuracy-aware
  containment; also exports the underlying `haversineMetres`, `isInsideCircle`
  and `isInsidePolygon` primitives. Multi-fence helpers live in `policy`.
- `coordination`: the fixed human-to-human vocabulary `buzz` renders
  (`COORDINATION_LABELS`, `coordinationLabel`, `coordinationActionFromLabel`,
  `isGroupCoordinationAction`, `isDirectCoordinationAction`); root import only,
  no dedicated subpath.
- `policy`: the disclosure-on-event decision (`decideEmission`); precedence
  `help > pickup > breach > night-out coarse > withhold`, with `offGrid` and
  `noReportZones` applied as described under the API reference below.
- `signals`: `beacon`/`breach`/`pickup` (plus a `cover` decoy type) and `help`
  duress → unsigned kind-20078 events; builders derive keys and encrypt
  internally from the group seed.
- `nightout`: ephemeral groups (NIP-40 expiry), presence (derived: a member is
  "gone home" when their beacons go stale, default 600 s), separation outliers.
- `checkin`: dead-man's-switch: encrypted "I'm OK" heartbeats (any cadence),
  `ok`/`overdue`/`missed` classifier, local self-reminders (`selfCheckInStatus`),
  and "I've got this" acknowledgement + escalation (`buildAckSignal`,
  `classifyEscalation`) so a miss is handled by a person, not a single toast.
- `trail`: pre-SOS breadcrumbs: on-device rolling buffer (`pushCrumb`),
  disclosed only with a help/breach as a duress-keyed `trail` signal.
  `pushCrumb` takes no zone input and does not consult no-report zones.
- `noreport`: inverse fences that cap disclosure over sensitive addresses.
- `buzz`: encrypted "look at your phone" ping. `allclear`: stand-down with a
  coerced flag. `fences`: circle-wide safe-place sync (latest-wins).
- `rendezvous`: "be back by / meet at" with ETA + at-risk assessment.
- `meeting`: fair meeting-point request/share. `disband`: circle dissolution.
- `offgrid`: deliberate "going dark" pre-announcement. `spokenverify`:
  face-to-face pick-up verification words + silent duress word.
- `joined`: encrypted member-joined notice. `lost`: lost-device flag and
  ring request. `findping`: remote exact-ping request whose consent gates live
  on the receiving device.
- `radar`: pure distance/bearing/freshness/uncertainty guidance and cue rules
  shared with the native implementation. `radarSession`: the pure rules for a
  consented, time-boxed beacon-cadence lift between two members. Both are
  pinned by `compatibility/v1/radar-vectors.json`.

## API quick reference (exact signatures)

All `build*Signal` builders are `async`, return `Promise<UnsignedEvent>` (canary-kit's
`{ kind, content, tags, created_at }`), and throw `Error` on malformed input. Each
group-envelope builder has a matching `decrypt*(seedHex: string, content: string)`.
`timestamp` params are unix seconds and default to the current time when omitted.
Pubkeys are 64-char lowercase hex.

### Group and seed

```ts
// canary-kit, re-exported at the root
createGroup(config: GroupConfig): GroupState
// GroupConfig: { name: string, members: string[] /* hex pubkeys */, preset?, rotationInterval?,
//   wordCount?, wordlist?, tolerance?, beaconInterval?, beaconPrecision?, creator? }
// GroupState.seed is the 64-char lowercase hex string every builder calls `seedHex`.
```

`GroupState.seed` derives the beacon, duress and envelope keys, so the caller must keep it
secret: never log it or publish it bare. It reaches other members only through the
gift-wrapped invite/reseed channel (FLOCK.md §3.4). `buildGroupStateEvent` (kind 30078)
also comes from `canary-kit`.

### Geofence, policy, no-report

```ts
// geofence
isBreach(point: LatLng, fence: Geofence): boolean            // ONE fence
isInside(point: LatLng, fence: Geofence): boolean
classifyContainment(point: LatLng, accuracyMetres: number, fences: Geofence[]): 'inside'|'outside'|'uncertain'
haversineMetres(a: LatLng, b: LatLng): number
type Geofence = { kind: 'circle', centre: LatLng, radiusMetres: number }
              | { kind: 'polygon', vertices: LatLng[] }       // LatLng = { lat, lon }

// policy (multi-fence helpers live here, not in geofence)
isWithinAnyFence(point: LatLng, fences: Geofence[]): boolean
decideEmission(ctx: EmissionContext, precisions?: Partial<EmissionPrecisions>): EmissionPlan
// EmissionContext: { mode: 'family'|'nightout', position?: LatLng|null,
//   geofences?: Geofence[], trigger?: 'none'|'pickup'|'help', accuracyMetres?: number,
//   offGrid?: boolean, noReportZones?: NoReportZone[] }
// EmissionPlan: { action: 'withhold'|'coarse'|'full', precision: number /* 0 when withholding */,
//   reason: EmissionReason }
// EmissionReason = 'none'|'nightout'|'breach'|'pickup'|'help'
// EmissionPrecisions defaults (DEFAULT_PRECISIONS): { coarse: 6, full: 9, help: 11 }; each must be an
//   integer 1-11 or decideEmission throws

// noreport
type NoReportPolicy = 'withhold' | 'coarse'
type NoReportZone = { area: Geofence, policy?: NoReportPolicy /* default 'withhold' */, label?: string }
inNoReportZone(point: LatLng, zones: NoReportZone[], accuracyMetres?: number): boolean  // false only if confidently outside all
noReportPolicyAt(point: LatLng, zones: NoReportZone[], accuracyMetres?: number): NoReportPolicy | null
```

`decideEmission` rules, in order (all pure, deterministic):

1. `trigger: 'help'` gives `full` at `precisions.help` (reason `help`); `'pickup'` gives `full` at
   `precisions.full` (reason `pickup`). These fire even when `offGrid` is true. With no
   `position` they return `withhold` (precision 0) but keep the reason, so a location-less
   alert can still be sent.
2. Otherwise `offGrid: true` returns `withhold` / `none`: it suppresses all automatic emission.
3. Otherwise no `position` returns `withhold` / `none`.
4. `mode: 'family'`: `full` at `precisions.full` with reason `breach` only when
   `classifyContainment(position, accuracyMetres ?? 0, geofences) === 'outside'` and there is at
   least one fence. An `uncertain` fix (the accuracy disc straddles a fence edge) never breaches,
   so a noisy fix cannot raise a false alarm. Anything else is `withhold`.
5. `mode: 'nightout'`: always `coarse` at `precisions.coarse`, reason `nightout`.
6. `noReportZones` apply last, to the result above (including help and pickup), and only when a
   `position` exists. The cap applies unless the fix is confidently outside the zone, so a larger
   `accuracyMetres` makes it more likely to apply (it fails safe, the opposite direction to
   breach). The strictest matching zone policy wins: `withhold` (the default) returns `withhold`
   / precision 0 and keeps the reason; `coarse` returns action `coarse` at
   `min(precision, precisions.coarse)`. A plan that is already `withhold` is unchanged.
7. `accuracyMetres` defaults to 0 (treat the fix as exact); wherever containment is evaluated
   (family breach check, no-report zones) it must be finite and ≥ 0 or `Error` is thrown.

### Location and duress signals

```ts
// signals: async; encryption + key derivation happen inside the builder
buildLocationSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, signalType: LocationSignalType,
  geohash: string, precision: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
// LocationSignalType = 'beacon'|'breach'|'pickup'|'cover'  (beacon key; 'cover' is a decoy that receivers drop)
buildHelpSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  location: { geohash: string, precision: number, locationSource: 'beacon'|'verifier' } | null,
  scope?: 'group'|'persona'|'master', originGroupId?: string }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // duress key
signalTypeForReason(reason: EmissionReason): SignalType | null   // SignalType = LocationSignalType | 'help'; null for 'none'
```

### Night-out

```ts
// nightout: presence is DERIVED from beacon staleness; there is no "mark gone home" setter
nightOutExpiry(startedAt: number, durationSeconds: number): number
buildNightOutGroupEvent(p: { groupId: string, members: string[], encryptedContent: string,
  startedAt: number, durationSeconds: number, rotationInterval?: number, tolerance?: number }): UnsignedEvent
  // SYNC, kind 30078, NIP-40 expiration; encryptedContent is encrypted by the CALLER
classifyPresence(beacons: MemberBeacon[], now: number, opts?: { staleAfterSeconds?: number }): PresenceEntry[]
stillOut(entries: PresenceEntry[]): PresenceEntry[]
geoOutliers(points: { member: string, position: LatLng }[], thresholdMetres: number): string[]  // median-centre outliers
// MemberBeacon = { member: string, geohash: string, precision: number, timestamp: number }
// PresenceEntry = { member, status: 'active'|'stale', lastSeen: number, ageSeconds: number, geohash: string }
```

### Check-in and escalation

```ts
// checkin (group envelope key)
buildCheckInSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  intervalSeconds: number, timestamp?: number,
  battery?: 'low'|'critical' }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // interval <= 0 stands down
classifyCheckins(checkins: CheckIn[], now: number, opts?: { graceSeconds?: number }): CheckInState[]  // grace default 300
missedCheckins(states: CheckInState[]): CheckInState[]
selfCheckInStatus(mine: CheckIn | null, now: number, opts?: { remindBeforeSeconds?: number,
  graceSeconds?: number }): 'none'|'ok'|'due-soon'|'overdue'|'missed'  // LOCAL only, never emits; remind default 600
buildAckSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string, target: string,
  timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // "I've got this" for target's missed check-in
classifyEscalation(states: CheckInState[], acks: CheckInAck[], now: number,
  opts?: { stepSeconds?: number }): EscalationState[]  // unacknowledged first, levels 0-2; step default 600
// CheckIn = { member: string, timestamp: number, intervalSeconds: number, battery?: 'low'|'critical' }
// CheckInState = { member, status: 'ok'|'overdue'|'missed', lastCheckIn: number,
//   dueAt: number /* Infinity if stood down */, missedAt: number /* dueAt + grace */, ageSeconds: number }
// CheckInAck = { member: string /* acknowledger */, target: string, timestamp: number }
// EscalationState = { member: string, status: 'unacknowledged'|'acknowledged', level: 0|1|2,
//   missedAt: number, acknowledgedBy?: string, acknowledgedAt?: number }
```

### Trail

```ts
// trail: buffer is memory-only; disclosure only rides a help/breach
pushCrumb(crumbs: Breadcrumb[], crumb: Breadcrumb, opts?: { maxCrumbs?: number,
  maxAgeSeconds?: number, minSpacingSeconds?: number }): Breadcrumb[]  // pure; skips too-soon/older crumbs
buildTrailSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  reason: 'help'|'breach', crumbs: Breadcrumb[], timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // DURESS key
// Breadcrumb = { geohash: string, precision: number, timestamp: number }
// defaults: max 12 crumbs, 900 s max age, 60 s min spacing; 1-12 crumbs per signal
```

### Circle pings and lifecycle (group envelope key)

```ts
buildBuzzSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, from: string, action: BuzzAction,
  target?: string, timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
// BuzzAction = 'check_in' | 'on_my_way' | 'ring_lost_phone'. ring_lost_phone REQUIRES a target;
// the other two reject one. check_in carries ask: 'location' (an ask, never an auto-disclosure).
// decryptBuzz -> Buzz = { from, action, reason: string /* fixed label */, target?, timestamp, ask?: 'location' }
buildAllClearSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, member: string, timestamp?, coerced?: boolean }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
  // AllClear = { member, timestamp, coerced? }; a coerced: true all-clear is meant to be ignored by
  // receivers so the alarm stays live (the flag is inside the encryption)
buildJoinedSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, member: string, timestamp?, handle?: string }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
  // handle trimmed, at most MAX_HANDLE (40) chars
buildDisbandSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, by: string, reason?: string, timestamp? }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
buildLostSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, member: string, by: string, lost: boolean,
  timestamp?, message?: string }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>   // message trimmed to 200 chars; latest per member wins
buildFindPingSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, from: string, target: string, timestamp? }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
  // the ASK only (t=findreq); the answer is an ordinary beacon; consent gates live in the app
// coordination vocabulary (root import only): COORDINATION_LABELS = { check_in: 'Check in',
//   on_my_way: 'On my way', where_are_you: 'Where are you?', call_me: 'Call me', come_to_me: 'Come to me' }
// GROUP_COORDINATION_ACTIONS = ['check_in','on_my_way']; DIRECT_COORDINATION_ACTIONS =
//   ['come_to_me','where_are_you','call_me','on_my_way']
```

### Fences, rendezvous, meeting, off-grid

```ts
buildFencesSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, set: FenceSet }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
isNewerFenceSet(incoming: { updatedAt: number, by: string },
  current?: { fencesUpdatedAt?: number, fencesBy?: string }): boolean   // latest wins; tie-break smaller `by`
// FenceSet = { fences: Geofence[] /* at most MAX_FENCES = 50 */, updatedAt: number, by: string }

buildRendezvousSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, rendezvous: Rendezvous }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
buildRendezvousStatusSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, status: RendezvousStatus }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
etaSeconds(distanceMetres: number, mode: TravelMode): number   // straight-line; SPEED_KMH walk 5, cycle 15, drive 30, transit 20
assessArrival(rendezvous: Rendezvous, member: string, position: LatLng, mode: TravelMode, now: number,
  opts?: { arrivalRadiusMetres?: number }): RendezvousProgress   // arrival radius default 60 m
// Rendezvous = { id, place: LatLng & { label?, address?, geohash? }, deadline: number,
//   mode: 'be-back'|'meet-at', setBy: string, createdAt: number }
// RendezvousStatus = { rendezvousId, member, status: 'enroute'|'arrived'|'at-risk', etaSeconds, timestamp }
// RendezvousProgress = { member, status, distanceMetres, etaSeconds, leaveBy, slackSeconds }
// TravelMode = 'walk'|'cycle'|'drive'|'transit'

buildMeetingRequestSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, request: MeetingRequest }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
buildMeetingShareSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, share: MeetingShare }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
parseMeetingShare(o: unknown): MeetingShare | null    // non-throwing
// MeetingRequest = { id, setBy, mode: TravelMode, maxTimeMinutes: number, createdAt }
// MeetingShare = { requestId, member, geohash /* coarse, caller-encoded */, precision: 1-11, mode, timestamp }

buildOffGridSignal(p: { groupId, seedHex, from: string, until: number, reason?: string,
  timestamp? }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>   // reason at most 280 chars
isOffGrid(o: OffGrid, nowSec: number): boolean   // OffGrid = { from, until, reason?, timestamp }; true while until > now
```

### Spoken pick-up verification (local, publishes nothing)

```ts
spokenCounter(nowSec: number): number            // SPOKEN_VERIFY = { wordCount: 1, tolerance: 1, rotationSeconds: 3600 }
spokenWordsFor(seedHex: string, memberPubkey: string, counter: number,
  memberPubkeys: readonly string[]): { verify: string, duress: string }
checkSpokenWord(spoken: string, seedHex: string, memberPubkeys: readonly string[],
  counter: number): { status: 'verified'|'stale'|'duress'|'failed', duressMembers: string[] }
  // pass the FULL roster; on 'duress' show the same UI as 'verified' and raise help silently
estimateSpokenVerificationRisk(memberPubkeys: readonly string[] | number): SpokenVerificationRisk
```

### Radar (pure guidance; mirrored by the native Kotlin port)

```ts
radarGuidance(input: RadarInput, opts?: RadarOptions): RadarGuidance
// RadarInput = { me: LatLng|null, headingDeg: number|null,
//   target: { position: LatLng, uncertaintyMetres: number, ageSeconds: number } | null,
//   myAccuracyMetres?: number|null }
// RadarGuidance.state: 'unavailable'|'no-fix'|'stale'|'coarse'|'arrived'|'no-heading'|'point'
cueFor(g: RadarGuidance, ctx?: CueContext, opts?: RadarOptions): RadarCue   // beep/haptic pattern, never sensors or audio
classifyFreshness(ageSeconds: number, opts?: RadarOptions): 'fresh'|'aging'|'stale'  // RADAR.freshSeconds 60, staleSeconds 600
// RADAR holds every tuning constant. Also exported: initialBearingDeg, resolveHeading, selectMode,
// smoothHeadingDeg, courseFromFixes, bleProximityFromRssi, voiceLine, clockFacePhrase and more (see src/radar.ts).

// radarSession: a mutual, time-boxed cadence lift; models no decline and no end reason
RADAR_SESSION = { requestTtlSec: 120, defaultTtlSec: 900, maxTtlSec: 3600,
  cadenceMovingSec: 5, cadenceStationarySec: 30, clockSkewSec: 30 }
clampTtlSec(ttlSec: number): number
requestOpen(req: SessionRequest, nowSec: number): boolean
supersedes(prev: SessionRequest | null, next: SessionRequest): boolean   // newest send time wins
acceptSession(req: SessionRequest, nowSec: number): RadarSession | null  // null once the ask is no longer open
sessionActive(s: RadarSession, nowSec: number): boolean
sessionRemainingSec(s: RadarSession, nowSec: number): number
sessionCadenceSec(moving: boolean): number
// SessionRequest = { requestId: string, ttlSec: number, sentAtSec: number }
// RadarSession = { sessionId: string, ttlSec: number, startAtSec: number }
```

Never change radar or radarSession behaviour without regenerating and reviewing
`compatibility/v1/radar-vectors.json` (`npm run gen:vectors`).

## From decision to published event

Geohash encoding is the caller's job (`geohash-kit`'s `encode(lat, lon, precision)`);
`geohash-kit` and `nostr-tools` are not re-exported from the root, so add them to your
own dependencies. Group creation (`createGroup`, `buildGroupStateEvent`) comes from
`canary-kit`, re-exported at the root. The full pipeline (also in README.md):

```ts
import { createGroup, decideEmission, signalTypeForReason, buildLocationSignal } from '@forgesworn/flock'
import { encode } from 'geohash-kit'
import { generateSecretKey, getPublicKey } from 'nostr-tools/pure'
import { wrapEvent } from 'nostr-tools/nip59'

const mySecretKey = generateSecretKey()
const friendPubkey = getPublicKey(generateSecretKey())
const group = createGroup({ name: 'Night out', members: [getPublicKey(mySecretKey), friendPubkey] })
const seedHex = group.seed   // keep secret
const groupId = 'night-out-1'

const position = { lat: 51.5007, lon: -0.1246 }
const plan = decideEmission({ mode: 'nightout', position })
const signalType = signalTypeForReason(plan.reason)
if (plan.action !== 'withhold' && signalType !== null && signalType !== 'help') {   // help: buildHelpSignal
  const geohash = encode(position.lat, position.lon, plan.precision)
  const inner = await buildLocationSignal({ groupId, seedHex, signalType, geohash, precision: plan.precision })
  const wrap = wrapEvent(inner, mySecretKey, friendPubkey)   // per recipient; publish `wrap` (kind 1059), never `inner`
}
```

**Gift-wrapping is mandatory before publish** (FLOCK.md §3.3): the library has no wrap
helper, so use `nostr-tools`'s `nip59` module (`wrapEvent(event, senderSecretKey,
recipientPubkey)`, once per recipient). NIP-59 keeps the inner
event an unsigned rumour and the seal carries the sender's signature, so do not call
`finalizeEvent` on the inner event first. `wrapEvent` tags the wrap with `p` only; it does
not add the NIP-40 `expiration` that FLOCK.md §6 asks every wrap to carry, so an app that
wants bounded relay retention builds its own wrap from `createRumor`, `createSeal` and
`createWrap`. Publishing an unwrapped signal violates the privacy model.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): overview, install, Quick start, module list
- [FLOCK.md](FLOCK.md): protocol spec: event kinds, payload shapes, privacy invariants
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent instructions (commands, structure, security-critical paths)

## Conventions

British English. ESM-only, ES2022. TDD: failing test first. Library modules
stay pure (return new state, no mutation). Geohash encoding and decoding stay
at the edge: `geohash-kit` is a runtime dependency used only for geometry in
`geofence` (`distanceFromCoords` behind `haversineMetres`, plus the polygon and
bounds predicates behind accuracy-aware containment), never to encode or decode
a geohash. Payload encryption happens inside the builders as described above;
the caller adds NIP-44 at the Nostr edge (NIP-59 gift-wrap, the
caller-encrypted `buildNightOutGroupEvent` content). Commits: `type: description`,
no Co-Authored-By lines. NIP-44 encryption (never NIP-04); NIP-40 `expiration`
tag (never `expiry`).

## Flock application status (not this package's API)

This describes the Flock app that consumes the package, not anything this package
ships or owns. The package has no UI, relay selection or app lifecycle.

- **Shipped app surface:** multiple trusted-adult circles; ongoing/today/custom
  lifetimes; QR/link/six-word/remote-signer invites; default-off live sharing
  with geohash precision 3–9; map, encrypted group chat and DMs; roll-call and
  direct quick actions; temporary exact festival mode; lost/ring/consent-gated
  exact find; foreground radar; backup/reseed/remove/disband; offline PMTiles;
  Tor/onion routing; App Lock and decoy view; local or external signing.
- **Android native:** background fix→policy→encrypt→gift-wrap→relay publish is
  shipped in Kotlin and hardware-verified while locked/walking and in stationary
  deep Doze on GrapheneOS. Opt-in **Stay reachable** keeps a persistent Nostr
  relay path for app-closed inbound alerts. This is not UnifiedPush. The native
  locked-phone radar guide is built/JVM-vector-tested but still needs its field
  pass; the live GrapheneOS/Orbot beacon pass is also pending.
- **Library-only/parked from the app UI:** geofence breach, SOS/duress,
  dead-man's-switch check-ins, breadcrumb trail, no-report zones,
  rendezvous/fair meeting point, off-grid, and spoken pickup verification.
- **iOS:** foreground PWA only; there is no native iOS background path.
